sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Kashkari’s hawkish pivot triggered midday panic: Minneapolis Fed President Kashkari shifted his stance from “one rate cut” this year to “one rate hike,” citing broadening inflationary pressures. Combined with yesterday’s May PCE reading of 4.1% YoY (core 3.4%, both the highest since 2023), the market repriced the rate-hike path. SPY was briefly knocked down intraday to a low of 726.88 (open 728.88), then staged a V-shaped recovery and is currently at 734.58 (+0.17%).
  • Market immune to Trump’s double-barreled “verbal bombs”: Around 11:51 ET, Trump posted threats to impose 100% tariffs on any country levying a digital services tax (DST), and accused Iran of launching at least four suicide drones at commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, “maliciously violating the ceasefire.” The two supposedly bearish headlines only triggered a brief several-dollar pullback in SPY before being absorbed by dip-buying—the community consensus is that the market has been “desensitized” to such events.
  • MSFT became the undisputed star of the session: MSFT +5.09% ($370.37, intraday high 371.49), rebounding for a second straight day and pulling SaaS names higher: NOW +8.26%, IBM +4.86%, CRM +4.37%, PLTR +5.55%; only ORCL -1.55% lagged alone as the “abandoned child.”
  • Memory/semiconductor crash intensified rotation: Dragged down by a sharp KOSPI selloff and Samsung’s announcement of a 1,000 trillion won-level capacity expansion, WDC -11.48%, SNDK -7.23%, SOXL -11.54%, MU -2.94%, AMD -2.18%, INTC -2.79%. Capital clearly rotated out of memory/chips and back into software + Mag7.
  • Oil weakened against the geopolitical backdrop: Despite the Hormuz attack, crude fell instead of rising (the community repeatedly exclaimed “oil down 3-4%”), with the war premium continuing to be washed out. Energy stock BE -13.07% led the declines.
  • Russell/FTSE quarter-end rebalancing: Today was the rebalancing execution day, and the community broadly attributed the low-volume intraday chop and potential late-day volume spike to this factor.

社区氛围：总体而言，这是一场“反复违反、疲惫不堪的混乱”——多头和空头在 SPY 732-736 的狭窄区间内同时被斩杀。午盘卡什卡里+特朗普的看跌催化剂短暂地让空头欢欣鼓舞，但微软金融时报(MSFT)引领的强劲复苏将“反向指标文化”和“算法操纵理论”重新推上了头版。语气偏向乐观，带着一层黑色幽默。

恐惧/贪婪：处于中立到贪婪的状态，“极度恐惧刚刚解除”。 VIX一度突破20，然后回落，导致多名用户开玩笑说“今天极度恐惧已经停止了”。 WSB 情绪与实际价格走势截然不同：评论区整整一周都在大喊“市场即将崩盘/黑色星期一”，而指数仅小幅下跌，与 ATH 相差不远； IWM 今年迄今增长了 22%，这是自 1991 年以来最强劲的开局。
